notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): add prompt identity and command execution backend seams
notes.summary: Workspace-host gains an optional prompt identity and a pluggable command execution backend, and the OpenAI-compatible provider now forwards the Meridian session-affinity option it previously dropped.

notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): delegate file tools to the execution backend
notes.summary: File reads, writes, search and the git status probe can now run through an injected execution backend, with a new filesystem port in node-host; local behaviour is unchanged by default.

notes.subject: feat(server): add standalone assistant server access layer
notes.summary: Adds the standalone assistant server access layer: HTTPS-only listener, owner bootstrap, device pairing, cookie sessions, passphrase reauthentication, request guarding and rate limiting.

notes.subject: feat(server): mount workspace sessions on the authenticated server
notes.summary: The assistant server can now create workspace sessions, stream turn events over SSE, run server-owned turns and take approvals bound to an exact interaction; core and workspace-host gain supporting exports and options.

notes.subject: feat(server): add runnable service entry point with systemd and launchd definitions
notes.summary: Adds a runnable assistant server with a JSON config, an agentlink-server CLI with --check, a bundled build, systemd and launchd definitions, crash recovery of interrupted sessions, and new turns allowed after an interruption.

notes.subject: feat(server): add local recovery for lost owner access
notes.summary: Adds an agentlink-server recover command and a /api/auth/recover endpoint so the owner can sign in again after losing all sessions, and the last active device can now be revoked.

notes.subject: feat(server): add a name-constrained local CA for device trust
notes.summary: The assistant server can create a name-constrained local CA, issue and auto-renew its HTTPS certificate, and export the CA for devices via a new export-ca command, selected by tls.localCa in config.

notes.subject: feat(server): add ChatGPT sign-in and a hardened container deployment
notes.summary: The assistant server gains ChatGPT (Codex) sign-in with codex-login/codex-logout commands, a hardened Docker container deployment, and more robust file locks. The node-host Codex OAuth manager can now use custom storage and finish sign-in from a pasted redirect URL.

notes.subject: feat(server): run Meridian beside the assistant container
notes.summary: The assistant can run Meridian as an unpublished sibling container to offer Claude models. Provider base URLs may use plain HTTP to a single-label container name when allowInsecureHttp is set.

notes.subject: feat(server): choose a model per session and route reviews to a role
notes.summary: Assistant sessions can choose any declared model or a named role such as review, with new routes to list models and change a session's model between turns.

notes.subject: feat(server): run background agents and route reviews to the review model
notes.summary: Agents can start read-only background children, such as a reviewer on a role-selected model. The assistant server gains routes to list, steer, stop and approve those children.

notes.subject: feat(server): push background agent progress and completion to the parent stream
notes.summary: Background agent lifecycle, phase and current-tool changes are pushed to the parent session's event stream, so clients no longer need to poll. The supervisor also tracks tool completion more accurately.

notes.subject: feat(server): run approved commands on a separate hardened command worker
notes.summary: The assistant can run owner-approved commands, git and ripgrep on a separate hardened command worker. The assistant image is now distroless without a shell, git or ripgrep, so existing container setups must add the worker or drop ripgrepPath.

notes.subject: feat(server): keep session event logs across restarts
notes.summary: Session event logs are now persisted to disk, so reconnecting clients can replay missed events after a clean restart, while a crash rotates the epoch and resets old cursors.

notes.subject: ci(server): build, test and smoke-test the assistant server on Linux
notes.summary: Adds a CI job and a container smoke-test script that build, test and verify the assistant server and command worker on Linux, with no change to shipped behavior.

notes.subject: feat(server): serve a first web app for the assistant
notes.summary: The assistant server now serves an embedded web app for setup, pairing, chats with streaming replies, approvals, background agents, model selection and devices. Session snapshots gain a display-only transcript.

notes.subject: feat(server): add an HTTPS egress gateway for commands
notes.summary: The assistant server gains an HTTPS egress gateway that lets command-worker commands reach only allowlisted hosts (npm, GitHub, PyPI, nodejs.org by default), and the worker network no longer reaches host services.

notes.subject: feat(server): let chats work without approval by default
notes.summary: Assistant chats now run in-project file edits and foreground commands without approval by default, with a per-session approval-mode switch. Recorded tool authorizations are now single-use in the turn kernel.

notes.subject: feat(server): share the Ask Agent UI and sign in with pairing codes
notes.summary: The assistant now serves the shared Ask Agent UI and signs devices in with single-use 6-digit pairing codes from `agentlink-server pair`. The setup credential, passphrase, recover command and CSRF header are removed, and old access state is migrated.

notes.subject: feat(server): per-model thinking levels, full model catalog and Assistant branding
notes.summary: The assistant offers the full model catalog with per-model thinking levels and richer openai-compatible model settings. It also adds Assistant branding, extra command-worker tools and an mDNS alias service.

notes.subject: feat(server): projects with per-project chats, creation and settings
notes.summary: The Assistant web app gains a project switcher with separate chats per project, creating empty or git-cloned projects when projectsRoot is set, and project settings for name, default model, thinking level and AGENTS.md.

notes.subject: feat(server): live running, needs-you and unread status for chats and projects
notes.summary: The Assistant's chat sidebar and project switcher now show live working, needs-you and unread status, and chats keep running when you switch to another chat.

notes.subject: feat(server): per-project network presets, web_fetch and web_search
notes.summary: Assistant projects get per-project network presets (Open web, Dependencies only, Off) enforced by a signed egress policy, plus read-only web_fetch and web_search tools and an optional SearXNG compose overlay.

notes.subject: feat(server): read-only file viewer for chat file links
notes.summary: File links in Assistant chats open a read-only Monaco file viewer for the selected project's files, with path, symlink, binary and size protections.

notes.subject: feat(server): show background agents on the Assistant's Agent Fleet cards
notes.summary: The Assistant shows the open chat's background agents as Agent Fleet cards with transcripts, steering, stopping and child approvals.

notes.subject: feat(server): reopen the Assistant's Agent Fleet with /fleet
notes.summary: The Assistant adds a /fleet command that reopens the Agent Fleet panel after all agents have finished.

notes.subject: fix(server): run the mDNS alias publisher as a fixed system user
notes.summary: The mDNS alias service now runs as a dedicated agentlink-mdns system user, fixing a crash loop on Ubuntu; installs must create that user first.

notes.subject: feat(server): deliver background results and add an approval-mode toggle
notes.summary: The Assistant delivers finished background agent results as a result card and wakes the chat to report them, and adds an Auto-run / Ask first approval-mode toggle in the composer toolbar.

notes.subject: fix(server): wake chats with an auth that outlives the request
notes.summary: Fixes background-agent wake-ups silently giving up after the request closed, by giving server-owned follow-up work a detached sign-in that still ends on revocation, sign-out and expiry.

notes.subject: fix(webview): never show a negative Agent Fleet timer
notes.summary: The Agent Fleet strip no longer shows a negative elapsed timer for newly started agents.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): add an Assistant view and a browser gateway Assistant link
notes.summary: Desktop gains an Assistant view with a sandboxed persistent session and optional pinned local CA in Settings, and the browser gateway sidebar links to the Assistant in a new tab with a configurable address.

notes.subject: feat(server): scheduled jobs for the Assistant
notes.summary: The Assistant server gains scheduled jobs that send a prompt to a new chat on an interval, daily or weekly schedule, managed through new owner-only /api/jobs routes, with run history and unread run chats.

notes.subject: feat(server): Jobs and Inbox in the Assistant web app
notes.summary: The Assistant web app gains a Jobs panel and an Inbox with an unread badge, live-following of run chats with approval cards, and a server-side inbox for finished, failed, blocked and approval-waiting runs.

notes.subject: feat(server): Web Push notifications for the Assistant inbox
notes.summary: Each new Assistant inbox entry can be sent as an encrypted Web Push notification to devices that opt in, with per-device subscriptions, a notifications config option, and a Turn off control on /devices.

notes.subject: feat(server): create and manage scheduled jobs from an Assistant chat
notes.summary: Assistant chats can create, change, delete and list scheduled jobs via new tools, always requiring owner approval with an exact preview card, and the workspace host gains an approvalHostTools option.

notes.subject: feat(server): keep why a job run failed
notes.summary: Failed or blocked job runs now keep a redacted description of what actually went wrong, shown in Jobs history and the Inbox, via a new onTurnError hook threaded through the core engine, node host and workspace host.

notes.subject: fix(server): show a banner for every Assistant push, even with a repeated tag
notes.summary: Assistant push notifications now always show a banner even when a notification reuses an earlier tag, so repeated tests or run updates are no longer silent.

notes.subject: fix(server): let the notification worker load the app icon
notes.summary: The Assistant server now serves the notification service worker with a content security policy that allows its icon, fixing notifications that Chrome refused to show.

notes.subject: feat(server): coding tasks in isolated clones on their own branch
notes.summary: The assistant server can now run coding tasks in isolated clones on their own branch, via new /api/tasks routes and chat tools start_task and list_tasks that require owner approval.

notes.subject: feat(server): validate and review coding tasks before they are ready
notes.summary: Coding tasks are now validated by server-run owner-set commands and reviewed by a model from another provider, with fix rounds, new task states and repository validation settings routes.

notes.subject: fix(server): tell the task reviewer which validation commands are required
notes.summary: The task reviewer and fix prompts now list the owner's required validation commands so reviewers stop asking for changes that conflict with them.

notes.subject: feat(server): publish ready tasks as draft pull requests through a separate publisher
notes.summary: The Assistant can now push ready coding tasks to their own agentlink/* branch and open draft pull requests through a separate publisher, with GitHub connections, per-repository publish permission and a new GitHub panel in the web app.

notes.subject: feat(server): clone private repositories for tasks through the publisher
notes.summary: Coding tasks can now clone private repositories: the publisher fetches the base branch with the connection's token and the server clones from a bundle, so the token never reaches the server or the clone.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): Tasks view, Inbox entries for task outcomes, resizable sidebar
notes.summary: Adds a Tasks panel with evidence, history, read-only chats and Stop/Resume/Delete/Publish actions, Inbox entries and push notifications for task outcomes, and a resizable, responsive chat sidebar.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): find repositories through the publisher and pick connections by reachability
notes.summary: The Assistant can now list the repositories each GitHub connection reaches, search them from chats with a list_repositories tool, show them in the GitHub panel, and clone tasks with the one connection that reaches a repository.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): one-card task start and read_repository
notes.summary: Chats can propose a task's checks and first-time publish permission on a single approval card, and a new read_repository tool lets them list, read and search a repository's files without starting a task.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): reference repositories on coding tasks
notes.summary: Assistant coding tasks can name up to 3 other GitHub repositories as read-only references, cloned beside the task's repository, and commands are confined to the task's clone.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): tasks in the conversation and continue_task
notes.summary: Assistant task outcomes now come back to the chat that started them, tasks show as cards above the composer, and a new continue_task tool sends follow-ups to a finished task's branch and pull request.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): show tool inputs on chat tool cards
notes.summary: Chat tool cards for the assistant's job, repository, task and web tools now show the inputs the model passed.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): realistic turn limits, and tasks continue past them
notes.summary: Chat turns get larger step limits (more for coding tasks), and tasks that hit the per-turn limit automatically continue in the same chat instead of failing.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): pnpm and yarn in the command worker; missing check programs don't use fix rounds
notes.summary: The command worker image now includes pnpm and yarn through Corepack, and a check whose program is missing fails the task with a clear message instead of using up fix rounds.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): run checks with CI=true, and open chat web links in a new tab
notes.summary: Commands run by the assistant server now set CI=true so tools don't wait for prompts, and web links in chat messages open in a new tab.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): task chats are real chats, and messages steer running turns
notes.summary: Messages sent while a chat is working are taken into the running turn at its next break, and coding task chats are listed in the chat list with a badge and filters, stream live, and accept messages and Stop.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): long-running sessions with Auto Continue and a notify-only runaway guard
notes.summary: Assistant chats and tasks now run without step or time limits, continue automatically while todos are unfinished, share the chat's approval grant with background agents, and send Inbox notices with Stop or Keep going when a session runs long or looks stuck.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): the assistant chooses how to handle a request, with work here and no card for repeat work
notes.summary: The assistant can run coding tasks in the current chat with live progress and steering, and in auto-run chats repeat tasks and follow-ups on an already approved repository start without an approval card.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): session runners, one container per coding task session with models and tools on the control plane
notes.summary: The assistant can run each coding task's session in its own locked-down container via a runner manager, with model calls and web tools staying on the server. It is opt-in through a new `runners` setting.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): show finished task chats without starting their runners, and document session runners
notes.summary: Finished task chats are now shown from the assistant's saved copy of the last transcript, so opening the app doesn't wake every task's runner. Session runners are also documented.

notes.subject: chore(assistant): log which call starts a session runner
notes.summary: The assistant server now logs which call starts a session runner, aiding diagnosis without changing behaviour.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): remember sessions a runner does not have, so they never wake it again
notes.summary: The assistant remembers sessions a runner doesn't have, so reading them no longer repeatedly starts that runner.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): hash-chained audit log for coding tasks
notes.summary: The assistant keeps a hash-chained audit log of coding task changes, gate results, external effects and who asked for them. Check it with `GET /api/tasks/:id/audit` or `agentlink-server audit-check`.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): backups to an append-only store, with restore
notes.summary: The assistant can back up its deploy directory to an append-only restic store through a sidecar, with restore, `backup`/`backups` commands, and a backup status and Back up now button in the Inbox.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): stage backups with a plain copy, which works in the backup container
notes.summary: Backups now stage the data folder with a plain read-and-write copy, which fixes copy failures inside the backup container.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): controlled upgrades with drain, version checks and rollback
notes.summary: Adds controlled upgrades: `upgrade.sh` with drain, a backup, a version smoke check and automatic rollback. Also adds `drain`, `resume` and `smoke-check` commands, service version reporting, data format versioning, and an "Upgrading" notice in the app.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): keep chats by project ID so restores keep them; tell the owner about chats stopped by a drain
notes.summary: The assistant now stores chats by project ID instead of folder identity, so restored or moved folders keep their history. Existing chat history stored under the old folder identity is not carried over. Chats stopped by a drain also add an Inbox entry.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): signed audit checkpoints in the append-only backup store
notes.summary: The assistant signs audit log heads and stores them as append-only backup checkpoints, adds audit-check --checkpoints verification, and shows the last checkpoint in the Inbox panel.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): remote MCP servers with per-tool Ask/Run/Off, OAuth and audited calls
notes.summary: The assistant can connect remote MCP servers with per-tool Ask/Run/Off, OAuth or header sign-in, a new MCP panel, and audited tool calls from chats and tasks.

notes.subject: fix(workspace-host): tell the model about host-provided MCP tools instead of saying MCP is off
notes.summary: When the host provides MCP tools through approval tools, the model is told how to use find_mcp_tools and call_mcp_tool instead of being told MCP is not enabled.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): take over a coding task in a browser editor
notes.summary: Coding tasks can be opened in a read-only browser editor, taken over to edit, and handed back to continue, using per-task editor containers on a separate HTTPS port with audited actions.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): let code-server accept editor WebSockets behind the proxy
notes.summary: Fixes editor WebSocket connections being refused behind the proxy by forwarding the checked public host and dropping client-supplied forwarding headers.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): keep session runners' chats by task project ID
notes.summary: Fixes tasks continued after a redeploy failing with session_not_found by keying session runners' saved chats by task project ID.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): AgentLink built into the task editor, with models through the assistant
notes.summary: The task editor now has the AgentLink extension built in, with models served through the assistant's own backends via a per-editor token and a new editor.modelsPort setting.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): keep the build commit when packaging the editor extension
notes.summary: The upgrade script now keeps the build commit when packaging the editor extension.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): give read-only task editors a scratch folder for AgentLink's chats
notes.summary: Read-only task editors now get a scratch folder so AgentLink's chats can store state without making the task's files writable.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): keep scheduled runs waiting for approval across restarts
notes.summary: Scheduled runs waiting for approval now stay waiting across restarts and upgrades, and the upgrade drain no longer waits for them.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): persona, time zone and quiet hours
notes.summary: The Assistant gets a Settings panel and a propose_persona_change approval tool for its name, persona, owner name, time zone and quiet hours, with push notifications held during quiet hours.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): offer this device's time zone in Settings
notes.summary: Assistant Settings now offers this device's time zone with one click, which helps when a containerised server defaults to UTC.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): memory the owner can see, correct and forget
notes.summary: The Assistant remembers lasting things the owner says and uses them in later chats, with a Memory panel to search, edit, forget and export, a Remembered strip with Undo, and a new @agentlink/core/memory entry point.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): deleting a chat deletes it, with stated retention
notes.summary: Deleting an Assistant chat or task now removes its data (session, background agents, commands, events, Inbox entries), refuses while work is running, records audit text only as hashes, and Settings shows storage and retention.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): say that older audit entries kept their text
notes.summary: The Assistant's retention text and docs now say that audit entries written before this version kept their original text.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): watches that only ask a model when a page changed
notes.summary: The Assistant can watch a web page or feed and only ask a model when it changes, via the new watch_page tool. Job runs now record token usage with an unusual-usage notice, and web fetch and push delivery now use the checked connection.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): daily briefings with sourced sections
notes.summary: The assistant can schedule daily briefings with sourced sections (watch changes, news, calendar, email, open items), approved on a card, delivered to the Inbox with a count of unsourced items, and shown in the Jobs panel.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): email and calendar through MCP with always-ask tools
notes.summary: Briefings read the owner's calendar and email through MCP read tools. MCP tools gain an always-ask list that can never be set to Run, plus argument limits on Run, edited in the MCP panel.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): Home Assistant and other MCP servers on the owner's network
notes.summary: MCP servers on the owner's network (such as Home Assistant) can be added with an "On my network" option. Only the owner's own chats see them, and only read-named tools can be set to Run.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): browser research in a throwaway headless Chromium
notes.summary: Chats on Open web projects can browse JavaScript pages in a throwaway headless Chromium via browse_* tools, with downloads, uploads and password forms refused. The egress gateway now answers unauthenticated refused requests with a 407 challenge.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): expose browser DevTools through socat since Chromium binds loopback only
notes.summary: Fixes the research browser's DevTools connection by forwarding its port with socat, since Chromium listens on loopback only, and adds logging for browser startup failures.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): count push notifications and add a per-day usage report
fix(assistant): let chats run alongside one waiting on approval and make queue Remove/Edit work
fix(assistant): send the bare Host header on checked HTTPS connections
notes.summary: Fixes watches on GitHub feeds failing with "Too many redirects" by sending the bare Host header on checked HTTPS connections, and the same for push delivery.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): polish management panels and task navigation
fix(assistant): keep long task previews compact
notes.summary: Long task titles and code previews in the task list are now clamped so rows stay compact.

notes.subject: feat(guardian): review MCP and network approvals with Jev first pass
notes.summary: Approve for Me now reviews unapproved MCP tool calls and unseen public network destinations with Guardian, optionally letting TypeSafe Jev allow confident cases first, with human fallback for risky, denied or unavailable reviews.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): add guided release installation and image updates
fix(guardian): request human approval after MCP denials
notes.summary: When Guardian denies an MCP tool call in Approve for Me sessions, the call now pauses for a human approval card showing the reason and arguments instead of failing immediately; hard restrictions still apply.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): add confirmed browser updates and durable updater
feat(browser-gateway): add files, photos and camera buttons to mobile Ask Agent composer
notes.summary: Mobile and touch Ask Agent composers in the browser gateway gain Files, Photos and Camera buttons to attach images, PDFs and text files from the device.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): keep saved model and thinking level across catalog reloads
notes.summary: Desktop and Browser Ask Agent keep the saved model and thinking level when provider catalogs load or reconnect, instead of overwriting them with a temporary fallback.

notes.subject: feat(guardian): give Jev a larger human-history window and judge waiver steps individually
notes.summary: The optional TypeSafe Jev shadow reviewer now sees up to 32 recorded human answers instead of 8, and judges each command step individually so harmless helpers and read-only gh queries no longer count as incomplete human evidence.

notes.subject: feat(node-host): let Codex account saves check authority under the lock
feat(assistant): add a deployment guard shared by updates and the installer
feat(assistant): add browser setup, API-key models, optional features and uninstall
docs(assistant): point getting started at browser setup and installer features
fix(tools): accept authorised direct calls to deferred native tools
notes.summary: Models can now call deferred native tools directly by exact name without going through call_native_tool, using the same validation and approval checks, instead of getting an error.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): challenge every unsigned egress request
fix(assistant): bind runner approval grants to the answered card
fix(assistant): start only one continuation or hand back per task
fix(core): keep admitted steering messages when a model call fails
fix(assistant): give each task editor its own sign-in secret
fix(assistant): take a fresh backup for upgrade rollback points
refactor(assistant): share the task wire contract with the browser
fix(guardian): give Jev earlier typed instructions and ignore text-less messages
notes.summary: The experimental TypeSafe Jev shadow reviewer now sees all earlier typed instructions, and attachment-only messages no longer count as missing human evidence, fixing a permanent one-item evidence gap.

notes.subject: fix(assistant): show the owner the control plane's own card for runner approvals
fix(assistant): check the previous updater image before a rollback stops anything
fix(assistant): retire an update's rollback point when a feature is turned on or off
fix(tools): surface formatting churn and approval provenance
notes.summary: Write results now warn when format-on-save changes far exceed the reviewed edit and require a reread, and development builds can inspect host-recorded approval provenance for MCP and managed-network commands via diagnose_activity.

notes.subject: test(assistant): expect unreachable egress targets to be refused before the credential check

8739d5b3a1bf9de980ddc2e68d6842b473a59cf2.summary: Assistant projects get per-project network presets (Open web, Dependencies only, Off) enforced by a signed egress policy, plus read-only web_fetch and web_search tools and an optional SearXNG compose overlay.

3854f85f1de38e1048f63766d55249a70b115f99.summary: File links in Assistant chats open a read-only Monaco file viewer for the selected project's files, with path, symlink, binary and size protections.

2c0ed2c00df5dc860eb24ada67d3da51b0d06488.summary: The Assistant shows the open chat's background agents as Agent Fleet cards with transcripts, steering, stopping and child approvals.

4bbb98ce50fbb4117c53219bbe64416741255f19.summary: The Assistant adds a /fleet command that reopens the Agent Fleet panel after all agents have finished.

ecdcc06e049287045f08db9cf9f323e382e5ad75.summary: The mDNS alias service now runs as a dedicated agentlink-mdns system user, fixing a crash loop on Ubuntu; installs must create that user first.

00b0841975f5f7a7caaa7bf71def091fa35c7ce0.summary: The Assistant delivers finished background agent results as a result card and wakes the chat to report them, and adds an Auto-run / Ask first approval-mode toggle in the composer toolbar.

d2185cb7b446a3df802098eea8f92f348f68ed3f.summary: Fixes background-agent wake-ups silently giving up after the request closed, by giving server-owned follow-up work a detached sign-in that still ends on revocation, sign-out and expiry.

442661716834f51f346e7dc0d0fe855a0fbdbe58.summary: The Agent Fleet strip no longer shows a negative elapsed timer for newly started agents.

ccc48a2fb86277045ef127ed7ddae0f39253751a.summary: Desktop gains an Assistant view with a sandboxed persistent session and optional pinned local CA in Settings, and the browser gateway sidebar links to the Assistant in a new tab with a configurable address.

f94c295af5027f503f46f88942ee8f3a5ec54764.summary: The Assistant server gains scheduled jobs that send a prompt to a new chat on an interval, daily or weekly schedule, managed through new owner-only /api/jobs routes, with run history and unread run chats.

0dda1c93a2fc53a402fabf2570c315cbbc66e201.summary: The Assistant web app gains a Jobs panel and an Inbox with an unread badge, live-following of run chats with approval cards, and a server-side inbox for finished, failed, blocked and approval-waiting runs.

3da5b73e04bba755ac087ccc94f03c5b8a589524.summary: Each new Assistant inbox entry can be sent as an encrypted Web Push notification to devices that opt in, with per-device subscriptions, a notifications config option, and a Turn off control on /devices.

7ae36dac6fb9f13d42bb867666e1f06169412168.summary: Assistant chats can create, change, delete and list scheduled jobs via new tools, always requiring owner approval with an exact preview card, and the workspace host gains an approvalHostTools option.

b82851fe11bab35a1afc01c727883069903725ab.summary: Failed or blocked job runs now keep a redacted description of what actually went wrong, shown in Jobs history and the Inbox, via a new onTurnError hook threaded through the core engine, node host and workspace host.

0372a83e5db452a6bb15547394cf6759c15da53b.summary: Assistant push notifications now always show a banner even when a notification reuses an earlier tag, so repeated tests or run updates are no longer silent.

231cdcda343cccbf238758a1f061e6fd226febbf.summary: The Assistant server now serves the notification service worker with a content security policy that allows its icon, fixing notifications that Chrome refused to show.

ed28426a0fbc468fa230a37e78754d92e91f7350.summary: The assistant server can now run coding tasks in isolated clones on their own branch, via new /api/tasks routes and chat tools start_task and list_tasks that require owner approval.

616e877b53616a4a5f77dc793749e78577e89443.summary: Coding tasks are now validated by server-run owner-set commands and reviewed by a model from another provider, with fix rounds, new task states and repository validation settings routes.

1fd0734b53ebc0d9112084fc7aaa2cd315bad681.summary: The task reviewer and fix prompts now list the owner's required validation commands so reviewers stop asking for changes that conflict with them.

344b1159f04f4f717f2e379548586ecb8017fdd2.summary: Chat tool cards for the assistant's job, repository, task and web tools now show the inputs the model passed.

a4022290531c1aaf8623e46e18e8e90f831df5fb.summary: Chat turns get larger step limits (more for coding tasks), and tasks that hit the per-turn limit automatically continue in the same chat instead of failing.

15b0f7112896328934ebe7722650d2297e2e3249.summary: Commands run by the assistant server now set CI=true so tools don't wait for prompts, and web links in chat messages open in a new tab.

a51ba414d6dfa752d49e864c9b45561000fd1745.summary: The assistant server now logs which call starts a session runner, aiding diagnosis without changing behaviour.

dd3373fca78f1e8b4be057df21022d16e0add09e.summary: When the host provides MCP tools through approval tools, the model is told how to use find_mcp_tools and call_mcp_tool instead of being told MCP is not enabled.

50fbc610a6459c3b39cb6dcbc1efa1353940f6a7.summary: Approve for Me now reviews unapproved MCP tool calls and unseen public network destinations with Guardian, optionally letting TypeSafe Jev allow confident cases first, with human fallback for risky, denied or unavailable reviews.

dd819f3c9d12f09b8af7b97544b2e43bd5f118a2.summary: When Guardian denies an MCP tool call in Approve for Me sessions, the call now pauses for a human approval card showing the reason and arguments instead of failing immediately; hard restrictions still apply.

753ce8268a3ef529394ebe775605d5b79c7e74d6.summary: Mobile and touch Ask Agent composers in the browser gateway gain Files, Photos and Camera buttons to attach images, PDFs and text files from the device.

69cdcd2ef3a4899ea26d6b6d6aa0215476010519.summary: Desktop and Browser Ask Agent keep the saved model and thinking level when provider catalogs load or reconnect, instead of overwriting them with a temporary fallback.

a4f4e7f280d97051c64032a18f68aceee2ff8cb3.summary: The first-pass Guardian audit now keeps running after a command starts instead of being cancelled and recorded as a deny; telemetry reports unfinished audits separately.

27108a79f2e074884338de46aecfe26caeb534e7.summary: The optional TypeSafe Jev shadow reviewer now sees up to 32 recorded human answers instead of 8, and judges each command step individually so harmless helpers and read-only gh queries no longer count as incomplete human evidence.

5d0a1a9639a4a96c03dc812fe57791ed47469a50.summary: Desktop app updates now fully clean up the old app bundle and clear stale applied-update records, so a leftover backup no longer blocks later updates.

f197e1422486394963198bea440d3bcda8a121fa.summary: Models can now call deferred native tools directly by exact name without going through call_native_tool, using the same validation and approval checks, instead of getting an error.

b6ccce8d5ff471b7eb300ac3fe0a3069a6608e1d.summary: The experimental TypeSafe Jev shadow reviewer now sees all earlier typed instructions, and attachment-only messages no longer count as missing human evidence, fixing a permanent one-item evidence gap.

145cc82e54ace9df4007da6586397ca6255fb4a8.summary: Write results now warn when format-on-save changes far exceed the reviewed edit and require a reread, and development builds can inspect host-recorded approval provenance for MCP and managed-network commands via diagnose_activity.

9ecc9182b558ce5fa596dc12bb6a989caaa18de5.summary: The Assistant can now push ready coding tasks to their own agentlink/* branch and open draft pull requests through a separate publisher, with GitHub connections, per-repository publish permission and a new GitHub panel in the web app.

ee051d16609eb920809e35e9606d6d79a6ad9ca5.summary: Coding tasks can now clone private repositories: the publisher fetches the base branch with the connection's token and the server clones from a bundle, so the token never reaches the server or the clone.

a7ea6d6f4f0ca7c9370ac7785e1018c1cac879eb.summary: Adds a Tasks panel with evidence, history, read-only chats and Stop/Resume/Delete/Publish actions, Inbox entries and push notifications for task outcomes, and a resizable, responsive chat sidebar.

4e3babb8d750155f33943308b1fe24b52142de69.summary: The Assistant can now list the repositories each GitHub connection reaches, search them from chats with a list_repositories tool, show them in the GitHub panel, and clone tasks with the one connection that reaches a repository.

c3392576dce22a714d3a062f530261c36fee45af.summary: Chats can propose a task's checks and first-time publish permission on a single approval card, and a new read_repository tool lets them list, read and search a repository's files without starting a task.

24572597e878e1a919b6d837a13309ac268b964c.summary: Assistant coding tasks can name up to 3 other GitHub repositories as read-only references, cloned beside the task's repository, and commands are confined to the task's clone.

630a7dcf50382dfd08f10c42054d7e81e75ed6d3.summary: Assistant task outcomes now come back to the chat that started them, tasks show as cards above the composer, and a new continue_task tool sends follow-ups to a finished task's branch and pull request.

1ea1171f7e3376dcbc84569b05486d51e35e0316.summary: The command worker image now includes pnpm and yarn through Corepack, and a check whose program is missing fails the task with a clear message instead of using up fix rounds.

b553f41f735afdfe43d66ac321053115f7e888ae.summary: Messages sent while a chat is working are taken into the running turn at its next break, and coding task chats are listed in the chat list with a badge and filters, stream live, and accept messages and Stop.

33d3aa1c335d8f82f7c8f4538e29b01ea344ec76.summary: Assistant chats and tasks now run without step or time limits, continue automatically while todos are unfinished, share the chat's approval grant with background agents, and send Inbox notices with Stop or Keep going when a session runs long or looks stuck.

6e447ab54445519c9b4634e27d0e8a7cab51b133.summary: The assistant can run coding tasks in the current chat with live progress and steering, and in auto-run chats repeat tasks and follow-ups on an already approved repository start without an approval card.

06168451170a90231b5e1c9d6542b56331324a06.summary: The assistant can run each coding task's session in its own locked-down container via a runner manager, with model calls and web tools staying on the server. It is opt-in through a new `runners` setting.

4155e76a74b399ec0c338760ccef635f9bebfc18.summary: Finished task chats are now shown from the assistant's saved copy of the last transcript, so opening the app doesn't wake every task's runner. Session runners are also documented.

918cf44fe94cdde26e54aade3df1f733430f5c5e.summary: The assistant remembers sessions a runner doesn't have, so reading them no longer repeatedly starts that runner.

19af91afde4b6820eed84e19dce71e4787950b79.summary: The assistant keeps a hash-chained audit log of coding task changes, gate results, external effects and who asked for them. Check it with `GET /api/tasks/:id/audit` or `agentlink-server audit-check`.

78fe3f57c754f5496269b1c778a68a72e1068469.summary: The assistant can back up its deploy directory to an append-only restic store through a sidecar, with restore, `backup`/`backups` commands, and a backup status and Back up now button in the Inbox.

ca02d7dfc776682bcff1531a3c6af7361e9d830a.summary: Backups now stage the data folder with a plain read-and-write copy, which fixes copy failures inside the backup container.

e07307e35594f174baf8b07518572a9cac090131.summary: Adds controlled upgrades: `upgrade.sh` with drain, a backup, a version smoke check and automatic rollback. Also adds `drain`, `resume` and `smoke-check` commands, service version reporting, data format versioning, and an "Upgrading" notice in the app.

ec0f3164ebd3fc262523447c6d463bb127dc8fb8.summary: The assistant now stores chats by project ID instead of folder identity, so restored or moved folders keep their history. Existing chat history stored under the old folder identity is not carried over. Chats stopped by a drain also add an Inbox entry.

56b2de03bf89bf8cb2b4cd1ca036c38ef95dfbc8.summary: The assistant signs audit log heads and stores them as append-only backup checkpoints, adds audit-check --checkpoints verification, and shows the last checkpoint in the Inbox panel.

1ea72282cb68858987e5ae187acf9470cc93f4f5.summary: The assistant can connect remote MCP servers with per-tool Ask/Run/Off, OAuth or header sign-in, a new MCP panel, and audited tool calls from chats and tasks.

3ded2c18cb2c88dc1826fd389008e5e915b176ab.summary: Coding tasks can be opened in a read-only browser editor, taken over to edit, and handed back to continue, using per-task editor containers on a separate HTTPS port with audited actions.

aaaa860856ebab145dd614b106ba07b7e38161cd.summary: Fixes editor WebSocket connections being refused behind the proxy by forwarding the checked public host and dropping client-supplied forwarding headers.

11b37d9283ba335f56a1703f3a4afeb96c8895cb.summary: Fixes tasks continued after a redeploy failing with session_not_found by keying session runners' saved chats by task project ID.

aae6f3328b608c4ab18ac37a13395d4ecab97a07.summary: The task editor now has the AgentLink extension built in, with models served through the assistant's own backends via a per-editor token and a new editor.modelsPort setting.

ed4945972f5ecc2a0f8fa30e080ee79e3d0884ce.summary: The upgrade script now keeps the build commit when packaging the editor extension.

ba5b17b3873467536307529f7298324dcd8091dd.summary: Read-only task editors now get a scratch folder so AgentLink's chats can store state without making the task's files writable.

a5b296383f33c500eb7d1673591387f6c756e22f.summary: Scheduled runs waiting for approval now stay waiting across restarts and upgrades, and the upgrade drain no longer waits for them.

c49197065ef32e97167f59df9e60aaccc7d79ef5.summary: The Assistant gets a Settings panel and a propose_persona_change approval tool for its name, persona, owner name, time zone and quiet hours, with push notifications held during quiet hours.

38494f87b9dd2f42a8283d83207c152ee5ed6f25.summary: Assistant Settings now offers this device's time zone with one click, which helps when a containerised server defaults to UTC.

6cb5e8e3f4b3b07e3c97319f1772fffa22d88499.summary: The Assistant remembers lasting things the owner says and uses them in later chats, with a Memory panel to search, edit, forget and export, a Remembered strip with Undo, and a new @agentlink/core/memory entry point.

b51ff9aec7f1710f419653ec1a784b751d126274.summary: Deleting an Assistant chat or task now removes its data (session, background agents, commands, events, Inbox entries), refuses while work is running, records audit text only as hashes, and Settings shows storage and retention.

b7989e029fbf313815615a6c7ad4e575c868cf31.summary: The Assistant's retention text and docs now say that audit entries written before this version kept their original text.

ecf7988de61ba6e20618a36d7befe016b6968dde.summary: The Assistant can watch a web page or feed and only ask a model when it changes, via the new watch_page tool. Job runs now record token usage with an unusual-usage notice, and web fetch and push delivery now use the checked connection.

5fc84e9ecd4ddaa18c1edf7eb8473492f3052a22.summary: The assistant can schedule daily briefings with sourced sections (watch changes, news, calendar, email, open items), approved on a card, delivered to the Inbox with a count of unsourced items, and shown in the Jobs panel.

dfbd5d84bc33f3552299780f8d78d33329b3c253.summary: Briefings read the owner's calendar and email through MCP read tools. MCP tools gain an always-ask list that can never be set to Run, plus argument limits on Run, edited in the MCP panel.

9fa880d83057c5987f2939b94d19bf935d407785.summary: MCP servers on the owner's network (such as Home Assistant) can be added with an "On my network" option. Only the owner's own chats see them, and only read-named tools can be set to Run.

c84019dccbe1476b00a8372e13cbeedb37462afd.summary: Chats on Open web projects can browse JavaScript pages in a throwaway headless Chromium via browse_* tools, with downloads, uploads and password forms refused. The egress gateway now answers unauthenticated refused requests with a 407 challenge.

eee5304fe24d2f17feb43cac1941b092b99e71ba.summary: Fixes the research browser's DevTools connection by forwarding its port with socat, since Chromium listens on loopback only, and adds logging for browser startup failures.

f33e77568e9c6b6fb9d5644fd232f09daf5b5233.summary: Fixes watches on GitHub feeds failing with "Too many redirects" by sending the bare Host header on checked HTTPS connections, and the same for push delivery.

8c8830135a45638b6684055daa3e6b1b9815fe3e.summary: Long task titles and code previews in the task list are now clamped so rows stay compact.
